source_type: Godot 3.5.2 compiled bytecode token/line rendering, non-buildable

paths.prerequisites: A player, ally, enemy, or world clock reaches its 100 tick threshold; action queue or effect queue has work.
paths.decision: Eligible units are collected; effects are handled before ordinary actions.
paths.expenditure: The actor clock subtracts 100 on eligibility; queued effects are removed when dispatched.
paths.mutation: Active unit list, queues, cycle flags and turn state change.
paths.actual_consumer: ProcessQueue2.create_turn calls ToolAi.take_action; ProcessQueue.cycle_go_2 passes an effect to qe.check.
paths.time: Tick accrual depends on SPEED, world clock adds 5; one queued effect is processed per shown cycle_go_2 call.
paths.failure: Dead queued actors do not take the shown AI action; empty queues fall through to clock search. The100-iteration clock search is not an effect-chain limit; per-producer conditions remain separate.
paths.aftermath: game.new_turn or player unpause follows the displayed branch; front insertion can reorder pending consequences.

paths.prerequisites: Player alive, invoke level requirement met and use > 0.
paths.decision: Button invokes cast by title after decrementing use; event_invoke runs event keyed recharge and trait effects.
paths.expenditure: One charge is spent at button activation; separate event paths can gain or lose charges by configured labels.
paths.mutation: Invoke use counter changes; eligible traits enqueue buffs, bonus, heal or other named actions.
paths.actual_consumer: ToolInvokes.cast and event_invoke.check produce actions; ProcessQueue.run_queue and qe.check consume queued actions.
paths.time: Activation calls run_queue immediately; exact relation to other queued effects requires live behavior.
paths.failure: Dead, underlevel or zero charge blocks the cast at the button.
paths.aftermath: Button refreshes its displayed charge count.

paths.prerequisites: A named add_buff action with a living target and buff source/target fields.
paths.decision: Unique same-name buff extends duration; another existing form is queued for removal; otherwise new buff appends.
paths.expenditure: No generic resource cost occurs at this consumer; producer abilities may have costs outside this path.
paths.mutation: Target Buffs gains a cloned buff or an existing duration increases; effect actions may be queued.
paths.actual_consumer: qe.add_buff calls ToolMagicMaker.add_buff, which calls event_apply_buff.check.
paths.time: Applied during effect queue dispatch; replacement removal itself is queued.
paths.failure: Dead target is filtered by qe.add_buff; no claim about source death across every producer.
paths.aftermath: Player buff UI refreshes in event_apply_buff; trait dependent heal/damage can chain.

paths.prerequisites: A live defender takes typed damage; FireHealing and related traits require their individual type/position checks.
paths.decision: Damage checks resistance and traits, then changes HP; a queued heal runs only if both participants live and target lacks HP.
paths.expenditure: Damage is subtracted from defender HP; if player is healed a heal keyed invoke charge may be lost.
paths.mutation: HP, event_killer when HP falls below one, scores/messages and pending heal actions change. FireHealing in the cited path heals the attacker producing fire damage, not the defender taking it.
paths.actual_consumer: qe.heal calls event_heal.check; event_damage.check is the upstream damage event.
paths.time: Healing follows queue dispatch and can be invalidated by intervening death.
paths.failure: Full HP yields no heal; dead healer/target is rejected in qe.heal.
paths.aftermath: Heal amount is modified, clamped to maximum HP and life display updated.

paths.prerequisites: A legal player or unit movement action, or a same-tile wait action.
paths.decision: Movement checks active buffs; Entangle/Bleed schedule typed damage, then residence changes and adjacent Vigilance can attack.
paths.expenditure: No movement currency is shown in this path; time is handled by the action/turn queue.
paths.mutation: Tile resident and unit residence change; damage and attack actions can be queued.
paths.actual_consumer: ProcessQueue.player_move/unit_move calls event_move.check; qe.magic_damage_target routes a scheduled damage effect.
paths.time: Effect resolves on later queue dispatch, not at source insertion.
paths.failure: Out of range/blocked movement does not enter event_move; dead target rejects magic_damage_target at dispatch. BloodRetort and ChannelDeath producers require a nonempty Global.Enemies list; this is not proof that every referenced enemy is alive or that all combo chains terminate.
paths.aftermath: A wait calls check_wait and lacks the moving-only check_end branch; live behavior of swaps was not run.
